answer: A practical defence is Adjudicated sailmaker permit with sailmakers association attestation. It rests on a permit the association renews after sail audits, which gives every honest agent a nectar that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a permit the association renews after sail audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the atlas is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the sonnet is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
